Overall BiS.content:
Best in Slot Gear for Survival Hunter
Generally, we’re looking for gear with as much as Mastery as possible, while avoiding unnecessary Versatility. Critical Strike and then Haste are both very good as non-Mastery options. The gear below is a great list to chase as best-in slot.


Slot	Item	Source
2H Weapon	 Roostwarden's Bough	Windrunner Spire
Main Hand	 Belo'ren's Swift Talon	Belo'ren
Off Hand	 Farstrider's Mercy	Crafting
Head	 Primal Sentry's Maw	Tier Set
Neck	 Amulet of the Abyssal Hymn	L'ura
Shoulders	 Pauldrons of the Void Hunter	The Seat of the Triumvirate
Cloak	 Draconic Nullcape	Vaelgor
Chest	 Primal Sentry's Scaleplate	Tier Set
Wrist	 Fallen King's Cuffs	Fallen-King Salhadaar
Gloves	 Primal Sentry's Talonguards	Tier Set
Belt	 Scornbane Waistguard	Chimaerus
Legs	 Primal Sentry's Legguards	Tier Set
Boots	 Farstrider's Razor Talons	Crafting
Ring	 Omission of Light	Nexus Point Xenas
Ring	 Occlusion of Void	Nexus Point Xenas
Trinket	 Gaze of the Alnseer	Chimaerus
Trinket	 Radiant Plume	Belo'ren

At the start of the season, resources and gear are very limited, and the first few crafted pieces are crucial for progressing efficiently. Here is the best early crafting order for Survival Hunter using  Spark of Radiance, targetting the quickest power gains:
Craft  Blood Knight's Impetus or  Farstrider's Mercy with  Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt  Explanation 
Craft  Farstrider's Razor Talons with  Arcanoweave Lining  Explanation 
Craft  Adherent's Silken Shroud with  Arcanoweave Lining  Explanation 
Craft  Masterwork Sin'dorei BandExplanation 
Replace Low Item Level Pieces.
